tests.requirement: The main face and hair visibly preserve the provided facial proportions, brown eyes, short dark bob and fine separated bangs; no claim about actual identity.
tests.pass_rule: Original pixels make the main face and hair sufficiently visible to compare.

tests.requirement: Harvest field and a communal rural seed ceremony read in bright daylight.
tests.pass_rule: Daylight, agricultural context and communal observance all visible.

tests.requirement: The same woman owns both cupped seed-bearing hands and holds them above her empty dish.
tests.pass_rule: Both complete hands, their arm ownership, the seeds and the whole empty dish visible together; partial or hidden ownership is FAIL/UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS.

tests.requirement: Collective directed attention and her unresolved response make a shared rule feel coercive.
tests.pass_rule: Watching faces and her visible hesitating response support this reading; authorial story alone cannot pass.

source_specific_tests: To be authored only for actually exposed and selected sources after complete retrieval review, before generation.
